classification.difficultyReason: Use only the stated outside curved surface of the open pipe; direct circumference-times-length calculation.

content.prompt: The outside surface of a piece of open pipe with diameter 10 cm and length 80 cm is to be painted. Calculate the area to be painted. Give an exact answer and an approximation correct to 2 decimal places.

spec.description: Native analytic cylinder radius5,height80, near/far lower-rim visibility retained; rigid page rotation−90deg preserves actual horizontal axial orientation and whole diameter dimension. Closed cylinder unless explicitly open pipe in stem.
spec.answerVisibility: Original source givens only; no derived answer labels.

answer.worked:
Only the outside curved surface is painted; neither opening contributes a circular disk.
$$\begin{aligned}A&=\pi d h=\pi(10)(80)\\A&=800\pi\text{ cm}^2\approx2513.27\text{ cm}^2.\end{aligned}$$
